discovery_requirements._binding: These gates bind the INTERPRETATION OF SWEEP B, not only the confirmation.

row_handling.censored_cohort: derived from the common OFFERED request trace before any policy runs; verified identical across all 9 policies (offered, censored and horizon all single-valued)
row_handling.zero_baseline_rule: if baseline on_time_per_offered == 0 and candidate > 0, relative gain is recorded as +inf and the cell is REPORTED but does NOT satisfy the >=10% gate; it is flagged degenerate
row_handling.tie_rule: relative gain exactly 10.000% counts as satisfying >= 10%; comparisons use >= not >
row_handling.both_zero_rule: if both are 0, relative gain is 0.0 and the cell fails

region_selection.rule: REPORT EVERY qualifying contiguous region and freeze ALL of them for confirmation.
region_selection.explicitly_forbidden: selecting the single largest observed gain, or any post-hoc choice among qualifying regions
region_selection.contiguity: adjacent in the load axis (0.70,0.80,0.90,0.95) with all other axes held equal

confirmation.region: the exact discovered region, parameters unchanged
confirmation.confidence_interval: paired CI on the improvement must EXCLUDE ZERO
confirmation.manifest_requirement: every threshold goes DIRECTLY into the confirmatory run's immutable manifest, not into prose

integrity_precondition: No verdict may be computed unless audit_sweep_b.py passes: 77760 records, 77760 unique keys, zero missing/duplicate/malformed, 8640 per policy, 9 per config, all 11 hashes matching, canonical sort before SHA-256.
